messages:
Alex (Finance): heads-up for q1 close - we received a prepay from Partner X that includes a $120k annual prepayment + a potential vendor rebate tied to usage tiers. need consensus on deferral + how to treat the contingent rebate.
Maya (Accounting): do we have the contract language for rebate contingency? typically contingent consideration is recognized when probable and estimable. if not, liability until earned.
Jorge (RevOps): contract excerpt: 'Customer eligible for up to 10% rebate on annual spend if usage > 80% of committed credits by month 10. Rebate issued as credit on renewal or refund on request.' sounds conditional.
Claire (Sales Ops): sales confirmed customers historically hit threshold ~70% so borderline. no explicit guarantee.
Alex (Finance): proposal: defer full $120k on receipt, amortize monthly over 12 months. create separate contingent rebate liability account and estimate using conservative probability (30%) based on cohort. journal samples below. thoughts?
Maya (Accounting): agree conservative estimate. example journals: 
1) Receive cash (Jan 15): Dr Cash 120,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 120,000 (GLs: Cash 1002, DefRev 2305)
2) Monthly recognition (Jan-Dec): Dr DefRev 10,000 / Cr Revenue 4001
3) Contingent rebate estimate (Jan close): Dr Revenue (contra) 3,600 / Cr Rebate Liability 2410 
   - explanation: 120k * 10% rebate cap * 30% probability = 3,600
If later evidence increases probability, adjust estimate through P&L. If rebate is refunded as credit on renewal, reduce liability when issued.
Jorge (RevOps): do we need CFO sign-off for the estimate methodology? it's the first time we've carved out contingent rebate in this way.
Alex (Finance): @Maya please tag @CFO for visibility, but we can include reasoning & cohort backup in the journal request. also need a deferral schedule created in our close tool.
close-bot: Deferral schedule created: DEF-9127 linked to PartnerX Invoice PX-2026-11, amount 120000, frequency: monthly, start: 2026-01-15.
Claire (Sales Ops): will upload historical usage cohort for Partner X to the ticket. includes three similar customers with average attainment 72% over 12 months.
Maya (Accounting): add memo lines: "Partner X annual prepay - contingent rebate estimate applied per policy". I'll prepare JE to post by EOD.
Alex (Finance): thanks all. once journals are posted, i'll reconcile deferral balance and loop back if adjustments needed. closing thread after JE posted. :checkered_flag:
